Name: Kenneth's Tropical Harvest
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Tropical Harvest[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]16 fruits and 16 saplings for Kenneth's Seed Shop and Kenneth's Fruit Shop. Plant the saplings, pick the fruits, and bring a little tropical feel to your farm.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]16 fruits with 16 matching saplings, all in Shop7.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Plant a sapling like a normal fruit tree, wait for its season, and pick the fruit when it is ready. Some trees fruit in spring, some in summer, and some in fall, so there is always something coming up. The fruits are also sold on their own if you just want to grab some right away, and they are ready to eat or cook with.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop7 in game when you have time, and see what fits your farm.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Seed Shop - Shop7 for saplings[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Fruit Shop - Shop7 for fruits[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You buy with gold, no bars or gems needed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Seed Shop or Kenneth's Fruit Shop, Shop7.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the sapling or fruit you like. Plant the saplings, and use the fruits how you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Seed Shop - you need this so Shop7 shows up for saplings[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Fruit Shop - you need this so Shop7 shows up for fruits[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Seed Shop and Kenneth's Fruit Shop are also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop7.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other fruits and saplings from Kenneth's shops. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
